description: Create a golden dataset (POST /v1/eval-datasets, Pro+ only). items can carry up to 20 test cases with expected outputs. Up to 50 datasets per account. frozen=true freezes the population (items can no longer be changed or unfrozen — fixing comparability for regression verdicts).

frozen.description: true = freeze the population (items can no longer be changed or unfrozen). Omit = false.

items.description: Test cases (up to 20). Each inputText is fed to the target model, and expectedOutput is used as the judge's [REFERENCE ANSWER] for scoring.

expectedOutput.description: Expected output (optional, <= 4000 chars). Passed to the judge as the reference answer.

name.description: Dataset name (1-100 chars, unique within the account)

name: create_eval_dataset
